headlines.title: PayPal (PYPL) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Weigh Q2 And Deal Uncertainty
headlines.summary: Analysts have trimmed their central fair value estimate for PayPal Holdings, with the model price target moving from US$59.16 to US$57.07. The revision comes amid mixed research views, with some analysts highlighting Q2 earnings and asset value, while others focus on competition, questions about a takeover, and recent share moves linked to deal headlines. As you read on, you will see how this updated target fits into the broader PayPal narrative and what signals to watch next.

headlines.title: PayPal Debit Card Tops Javelin Strategy & Research’s 2026 General-Purpose Reloadable Card Scorecard
headlines.summary: Cash App Card and Wisely Direct named as Overall Leaders; P2P-linked cards signal new momentum in the prepaid market Javelin's 2026 General-Purpose Reloadable Card Scorecard Results PayPal Debit Card Earns Best in Class; Cash App Card and Wisely Direct Named Overall Leaders LIVONIA, Mich., Sept. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Javelin Strategy & Research has released its 2026 General-Purpose Reloadable Card Scorecard, finding that the market is no longer defined only by access and utility.

headlines.title: PayPal's Venmo Expands NIL Partnerships: Can It Support Growth?
headlines.summary: Venmo's expanded NIL campaign targets college audiences as PYPL pushes the platform beyond P2P payments and builds higher-value engagement.

headlines.title: Chief Risk Officer Trims Holdings of Fintech Stock, Sells 2,097 Shares for $110,428
headlines.summary: Insider disposed of shares through non-discretionary tax withholding following quarterly vesting of restricted stock units, maintaining beneficial ownership of 65,761 shares.

description: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates a technology platform that enables digital payments for merchants and consumers worldwide. The company operates a two-sided network at scale that connects merchants and consumers that enables its customers to connect, transact, and send and receive payments through online and in person, as well as transfer and withdraw funds using various funding sources, such as bank accounts, PayPal or Venmo account balance, consumer credit and debit products, credit and debit cards, and cryptocurrencies, as well as other stored value products, including gift cards and eligible rewards. It provides payment solutions under the PayPal, PayPal Credit, Braintree, Venmo, Xoom, Hyperwallet, Honey, and Paidy names. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
